Amanda (AE): Mercury Finance wants a 10-day POC. Requirements: Azure AD SSO, SCIM provisioning with group->role mapping, and 24-month audit retention for RBAC changes. Can we confirm feasibility and any extra costs?
Kesh (SE): We support SAML with Azure AD. For SCIM we do SCIM 2.0 with group sync and deprovision. We can provide sample mapping CSV and a tiny runbook.
Priya (Security): Hosted default retention is 12 months; 24 months is available as enterprise add-on (legal + DPA update). We store SCIM tokens encrypted with KMS and support manual rotation. mTLS for SCIM is Dedicated-only; hosted will use TLS + scoped bearer tokens.
Raj (Mercury): IP allowlisting required. For the POC we'd prefer Hosted if you can give a fixed egress set for the test window. Also need exportable CSV of audit events.
Kesh (SE): We can provide the hosted egress ranges for the POC window. Note ranges may change long-term. Exportable audit CSV available via Console/API.
Amanda (AE): Pricing: include SSO/SCIM in Hosted; retention and static IPs are add-ons or Dedicated. I'll propose a short POC concession and add-on for retention if they sign.
infra-bot: Created questionnaire: https://redwood.company/infosec/mercury-poc — assigned to Priya and Mercury.
Priya (Security): Action items: create questionnaire entry, add retention clause, confirm storage encryption details.
Kesh (SE): I'll push a 1-page runbook + mapping example and DM egress IPs. Raj please share Azure metadata by EOD.
Raj (Mercury): Will do. Thanks all.
